# Offline text fixture

These eight short passages were written for the Centauri Bloom tests. They
depict fictional scenes and contain no real people, contact details, private
records, or third-party quotations. The ninth input repeats the first with an
extra opening blank line so the tests can exercise normalization and exact
deduplication. “café” and the curly punctuation exercise UTF-8 encoding.

The passages are redistributable under [Apache-2.0](../../../LICENSE). The
fixture is suitable for exercising corpus construction and CPU training code.
Its size and fictional subject matter limit what evaluation scores can show.

Each input and its exact byte hash are listed in [sources.json](sources.json).
